title: Polynomial-time computability of the predicate bit
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $d,c,A,a$ be natural numbers. The function that maps each finite Boolean string $y$ to the one-bit string whose bit is true exactly when the initial-configuration check and accepting-configuration check for $N$ on the encoded input both hold, and either the base check or the disjunction of level checks holds, is computable by a deterministic finite Turing machine in time bounded by a polynomial in the input length.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
